clue.text: Worked miracle to effect recovery

indicators.note: worked in the sense of worked over or kneaded, so the letters of miracle are reshaped

explanation.surface: A healer performs a miracle to bring about a cure.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Worked' looks like part of the miracle story but tells you to rearrange MIRACLE.
explanation.definitionFit: To reclaim something is to get it back, which is bringing about its recovery.

clue.text: A cause of repeated ill-feeling

parts.note: not resentment between people, but falling sick again after seeming to recover

explanation.definitionFit: A return of illness after recovery makes the patient feel unwell once more.

clue.text: Being hardened, a summons is nothing to us

parts.note: a summons is a call
O is the zero shape for nothing
taken as written

explanation.surface: Feeling unmoved, someone shrugs off a court summons as trivial.
explanation.definitionFit: Callous describes someone with a hard, unfeeling heart, insensitive to others.

clue.text: Saw a number over a period of time

indicators.note: in a down clue over means placed above, so these letters come first

parts.note: D is 500 in Roman numerals
an age is a long period of time

explanation.surface: Someone saw a number overlaid on a time period.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Saw' looks like a verb but is a noun: an old saying.
explanation.definitionFit: A saw is a traditional proverb or saying, as in an old saw.

clue.text: Nurseryman's guarded forecast about hawthorn?

definitions.meaning: a gardener cautiously says a plant might bloom, using may for possibility
the hawthorn blossoms in May and is called by this name; the question mark marks it as one example

explanation.definitionFit: A cautious grower's prediction is that a plant possibly will bloom; the hawthorn is also called the may tree.

clue.text: Fire bar is an old piece of brass

parts.note: to fire someone is to sack them
bar as a preposition means except, as does but

explanation.surface: A fire grate's bar turns out to be an antique brass fitting.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Brass' here means a brass instrument: the sackbut is the early form of the trombone.
explanation.definitionFit: The sackbut is a Renaissance wind instrument of the brass family, the trombone's ancestor.

clue.text: Extra capital

definitions.meaning: a film extra is a supernumerary, shortened to this word
capital as an exclamation means excellent or splendid

explanation.definitionFit: A supernumerary actor is a film extra, and something splendid or first-rate is excellent.

clue.text: Dating somebody so rich, put in a spin

indicators.note: letters sent into a spin are whirled into a new order

explanation.surface: A rich person's dating life has them dizzy.
explanation.definitionFit: Wooing someone with a view to marriage is the old way of dating.

clue.text: Young Italian graduate doctor in love

parts.note: a BA is a Bachelor of Arts graduate
MB is Bachelor of Medicine, a doctor's degree
taken as written
love is zero in tennis, written O

explanation.surface: A young graduate doctor falls for an Italian.
explanation.definitionFit: Bambino is Italian for a baby or little child.

clue.text: Rude tot has to be made to be taught

indicators.note: the letters have to be made into something new, so they are rearranged

explanation.surface: A rude toddler needs some schooling.
explanation.definitionFit: To be tutored is to have been given private teaching.

clue.text: Rock music

parts.note: not the guitar genre but music used to rock a baby to sleep in a cradle

explanation.definitionFit: A cradle song is sung while gently rocking an infant until they sleep.

clue.text: Something special encountered if you go straight down

parts.note: a plum job or role is a choice, special one
encountered means met

explanation.surface: A special prize awaits whoever takes the direct route down.
explanation.definitionFit: To plummet is to fall steeply and sheer, dropping vertically.

clue.text: Jack's screwdriver?

parts.note: Jack is a sailor, and the ship's screw is driven round by this, so it drives the screw at sea

explanation.definitionFit: A ship's screw is its rotating bladed device that pushes it through water, and sailors are jack tars.

clue.text: Row about the right judge, perhaps

indicators.note: about means surrounding, so the row goes round the other letter

parts.note: a row of seats is a tier

explanation.surface: A dispute centres on whether the judge got it right.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Row' looks like a quarrel, but it is a tier of seats. A judge tries cases, hence 'perhaps'.
explanation.definitionFit: A trier is one who tries a case in court, and a judge is one example.

clue.text: After rest, student can provide support for teacher

indicators.note: after says the student letter comes behind the word for rest

parts.note: rest means ease, as in standing at ease
L is a learner, the plate on a learner driver's car

explanation.surface: After a break, a pupil props up the teacher.
explanation.walkthrough: L comes from the red L-plate a British learner driver displays.
explanation.definitionFit: An easel is the stand a teacher props a blackboard on, holding it up.

clue.text: One of those hung after views have been canvassed

definitions.text: One of those hung after views have been canvassed

parts.words: One of those hung after views have been canvassed
parts.note: not an opinion poll; scenery has been painted on canvas and the picture hung in a gallery

explanation.definitionFit: A painting of countryside scenery is put on canvas and then hung on a wall.

clue.text: Guard what one says — a good maxim

parts.note: to guard is to keep watch
giving your word is what you say or promise

explanation.surface: A guard's instruction to mind your words is sound advice.
explanation.definitionFit: A watchword is a guiding motto or slogan, a principle to live by.

clue.text: In the main, it records ups and downs

definitions.text: In the main, it records ups and downs

parts.words: In the main, it records ups and downs
parts.note: the main is the sea, and its rises and falls are listed by date and time

explanation.definitionFit: A chart of high and low water times shows when the sea rises and falls.

clue.text: Becoming angry when observing an indication you are in debt?

parts.note: observing means seeing

parts.words: an indication you are in debt
parts.note: a bank balance in the red shows money is owed

explanation.surface: Someone gets furious on reading an overdrawn bank statement.
explanation.definitionFit: Seeing red is an idiom for flying into a rage.

clue.text: Academy member holding an exhibition, perhaps

definitions.text: Academy member holding an exhibition, perhaps

parts.words: Academy member holding an exhibition, perhaps
parts.note: not an artist staging a show, but a student holding an exhibition, a kind of college award

explanation.definitionFit: A student funded by a college exhibition or award is a learned pupil of the academy.

clue.text: Witty saying has little point with animals

parts.note: E is the short form of the compass point east
a pig is a farm animal
a ram is a male sheep

explanation.surface: A joke falls flat when it involves animals.
explanation.definitionFit: An epigram is a short, clever remark with a pointed twist.

clue.text: Form a queue at the back

definitions.text: Form a queue at the back

parts.words: Form a queue at the back
parts.note: not lining up, but a queue in the old sense of a pigtail, braided at the back of the head

explanation.definitionFit: Braiding hair into a single tail down the back is the old pigtail called a queue.

clue.text: The school attendant is not responsible for it

definitions.text: The school attendant is not responsible for it

parts.words: The school attendant is not responsible for it
parts.note: an attendant at school is a pupil who turns up, so failing to turn up is not their doing

explanation.definitionFit: Being away from school is the opposite of attendance.

clue.text: An outside line to ring

parts.note: not a phone call but a straight line touching a circle from outside

explanation.definitionFit: In geometry it is a straight line meeting a circle at one point without cutting it.

clue.text: The first person an artist goes round and greets

indicators.note: goes round says the artist's name encloses the person

parts.note: Frans Hals was a Dutch portrait painter
the first person singular pronoun is I

explanation.surface: An artist circles the leading figure and says hello.
explanation.definitionFit: To hail someone is to call out a greeting to them.

clue.text: A portion's put out to kill vermin

indicators.note: put out in the sense of disturbed or disordered, so the letters are rearranged

parts.note: the S of the contraction is used as a letter

explanation.surface: A share of food is left outside to get rid of pests.
explanation.walkthrough: Here 'portion's' is 'portion is', so its S counts as a letter.
explanation.definitionFit: Rodenticide such as warfarin is laid down to kill rodents.

clue.text: In two ways, they can produce fine sprays

definitions.text: In two ways, they can produce fine sprays

parts.words: In two ways, they can produce fine sprays
parts.note: flowers make sprays for a bouquet, and the perforated nozzle of a watering can makes a spray of water

explanation.definitionFit: Garden flowers form sprays of bloom, and the sprinkler head of a watering can is named after them.

clue.text: Over one ounce of oxygen

indicators.note: in a down clue over means the ounce letters sit above the next piece

parts.note: taken as written

explanation.surface: Someone measures out more than an ounce of a gas.
explanation.definitionFit: This gas is a form of the element with three atoms per molecule, O3.

clue.text: They're thrown from horses in rodeos

definitions.text: They're thrown from horses in rodeos

parts.words: They're thrown from horses in rodeos
parts.note: not riders bucked off, but ropes cast by riders on horseback to catch cattle

explanation.definitionFit: Lassos are looped ropes cowboys throw from the saddle.

clue.text: Robin we snap with a box camera

indicators.note: snap means break, so the letters of the two words are broken up and rearranged

explanation.surface: Robin and I take photos with an old box camera.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Snap' looks like taking a photo, but it signals breaking up ROBIN WE. The Brownie was Kodak's cheap box camera.
explanation.definitionFit: Kodak sold a cheap simple box camera under this brand name from 1900.

clue.text: They suit lively children

parts.note: suit means both fit and a one-piece garment worn by a frolicking toddler

explanation.definitionFit: A playsuit for toddlers is named for the boisterous play it allows.

clue.text: The basic requirement for a live wire

definitions.text: The basic requirement for a live wire

parts.words: The basic requirement for a live wire
parts.note: a fundamental part, and the heating coil an electric current runs through in a kettle

explanation.definitionFit: A fundamental constituent, and also the resistance coil in a heater that carries current.
